name: Blinatumomab
route_note: Continuous IV infusion via portable pump, 28-day cycles

discovery.note: Two single-chain variable fragments joined by a linker, one binding CD19 and one CD3ε; about 55 kDa, without an Fc region.

tagline: First bispecific T-cell engager, linking T cells to CD19-positive leukaemia cells
summary: Blinatumomab is a bispecific antibody construct that binds CD19 on B cells and CD3 on T cells, directing the patient's T cells to kill B-lineage leukaemia cells. It is used in B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukaemia, including relapsed disease, measurable residual disease and consolidation.
mechanism: Blinatumomab bridges a CD3-positive T cell to a CD19-positive target cell, forming a cytolytic synapse independent of MHC and T-cell receptor specificity.

The engaged T cells release perforin and granzymes, killing the target cell, and proliferate and secrete cytokines, which can cause cytokine release syndrome. Its small size and lack of Fc give a short half-life, requiring continuous infusion.
uses: Relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B-cell precursor ALL (adults and children)
CD19-positive B-ALL in first or second remission with measurable residual disease
Consolidation of Philadelphia chromosome-negative CD19-positive B-ALL

history.title: Early clinical activity
history.detail: Bargou et al. report tumour regression in lymphoma at very low doses.

history.title: Amgen acquires Micromet
history.detail: Amgen buys Micromet and its BiTE platform.

history.title: FDA accelerated approval
history.detail: Approved in December for Philadelphia-negative relapsed or refractory B-ALL.

history.title: EU approval
history.detail: Conditional approval in the European Union.

history.title: TOWER trial
history.detail: Blinatumomab improves overall survival versus standard chemotherapy in relapsed B-ALL.

history.title: MRD indication
history.detail: Accelerated approval for MRD-positive B-ALL — the first FDA approval for MRD.

history.title: Consolidation
history.detail: Approved for consolidation regardless of MRD status after E1910 showed a survival benefit.

pk.metabolism: Catabolic degradation to peptides and amino acids
pk.excretion: Negligible renal excretion of intact drug

serious: Neurological toxicities including encephalopathy and seizures
safety.boxed_warning: Cytokine release syndrome and neurological toxicities, which may be severe, life-threatening or fatal.

facts: Blinatumomab was the first bispecific T-cell engager approved by the FDA.
Its 2018 MRD approval was the first time the FDA approved a treatment for measurable residual disease.
